title: THE POLE OF THE WORLD // THE HEART OF WINTER
narrative: Guided by the Three-Eyed Crow through the weirwood web, Bran's sight flew beyond the Wall, past the Thenn mountains, across the Shivering Sea, to the absolute pole of the world: the Land of Always Winter. There, under curtains of frozen blue light that danced across the sky, stood a fortress of living crystal ice surrounding an obsidian crater. In the center sat the Great Other upon a throne of frozen stars, his eyes two burning pinpricks of absolute zero. Bran felt the piercing gaze turn directly upon him through thousands of leagues of space, freezing his astral throat in terror.
resolvesPlotHole: The Geographic and Cosmic Source of the Others
